headline: KPK Clarifies Timing Of Asset Seizure From KAI President Director
seoTitle: KPK Clarifies KAI President Director Asset Seizure
metaDescription: The Corruption Eradication Commission confirmed the seizure of Rp2 billion from Bobby Rasyidin occurred in 2025, not during his current tenure at KAI.
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) stated that Rp2 billion was seized from Bobby Rasyidin in August 2025.
Officials clarified the investigation concerns alleged corruption in fuel station digitalization projects, not Rasyidin's role at PT KAI.
The director acknowledged the seizure and cooperated with the investigation by returning the funds.
aiContextParagraph: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has provided clarity regarding the recovery of Rp2 billion from the President Director of PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), Bobby Rasyidin. Spokesperson Budi Prasetyo confirmed that the funds were confiscated in 2025 as part of an ongoing investigation into alleged corruption involving the digitalization of fuel stations (SPBU). The KPK emphasized that the seizure was unrelated to Rasyidin's current capacity as the leader of the national railway company. Recent reports prompted the KPK to clarify that the event was not recent, contradicting circulating information that suggested a new action. Rasyidin has publicly acknowledged the situation, expressing regret while noting his cooperation with the commission throughout the legal process. The investigation focuses on irregularities within the procurement projects related to gas station technology infrastructure.
whyItIsViral: This story gained traction across four independent news outlets after public speculation emerged regarding a link between the KPK's asset seizure and the current leadership of the state-owned railway firm.
